description: Conversion of roof space to habitable use to include a rear dormer and 3 front roof windows
decision_conditions: The proposed development by reason of the rear facing dormer window and its proximity to the neighbouring property No.21 Honey Hill would result in a form of development which would not provide satisfactory amenities for that adjacent property, due to the loss of privacy and sense of overlooking that could arise. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D3 and D6 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies DMHD 1 and DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020).

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies from the  Local Plan Part 1, Local Plan Part 2, Supplementary Planning Documents, Planning Briefs and other informal written guidance, as well as offering a full pre-application advice service.
